audit_items.proof_trace: updateMemberAdmin performs four mutations (auth user_metadata, members table, member_team_relations, Discord sync) and returns without inserting to any audit log. A grep of the entire repository for user_edit_logs, edit_log, audit_log, and action_log returns zero results — the required user_edit_logs table does not exist anywhere in the codebase, so the property's enforcement mechanism is entirely absent.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A compromised or malicious admin can modify member names, generation, student_number, status, or team memberships; because no audit record is written, all changes are undetectable and no forensic trail exists for post-incident review.
